name: offset_position_from_reference_object
description: Moves the object's horizontal position by half a size field of the reference object, minus a fixed margin, and its vertical position by another offset of the reference object, unless a flag on the reference object is set. When the reference object's state is not one, it calls a helper and copies a masked word into the object's vertical field.

name: process_active_object_slots
description: Walks a fixed table of 32 object slots and, for each occupied slot, dispatches on its type word to collision and movement helpers. The routine also touches the background colour register.

name: select_object_state_from_flags
description: Sets an object's state from its status flags. One path moves it horizontally relative to another object and records a state word, another sets a timer field to a fixed count, and the last path writes a frame value built from the low five flag bits on top of a fixed base.

name: assign_frame_codes_from_flags

name: derive_offset_from_mode_byte
description: Sets a working value to a default of 32. When the object's mode byte is nonzero, it instead uses the object's size byte multiplied by 16.

name: resolve_vertical_contact_motion
description: Applies vertical motion rules to an object in a given state. When certain flags are set it sets a timer field to a fixed count and negates the working value, and when another flag pair is set it computes a new vertical value from the object's position and speed.

name: latch_object_when_in_window
description: Checks whether the working value lies within a small window around the object's stored position. When it does, it sets a short timer on the object, computes a new value and records the object as the current target.

name: emit_child_sprite_parts

name: emit_child_sprite_parts_ptr
description: Writes sprite entries for an object's part list in the same way as its sibling emitter, including the visible-window check and the release path for parts outside it. The routine also touches the background colour register.

name: recycle_offscreen_sprite_part
description: Counts down a timer field on the object, stepping it on odd horizontal positions. When the distance check shows the part has moved far outside the window, it frees the part and writes its frame codes into the sprite table.

name: recycle_stale_sprite_part
description: Keeps a sprite part while its tracked object is still inside the visible window. Otherwise it frees the part, decrements the live-part counter and writes its frame codes into the sprite table.

name: dispatch_code_and_check_patterns
description: Maps a byte code through a range-based switch and a lookup table, updating a counter and a shared state word. It then compares a running word against three fixed constants and, when one matches, overrides the state word with a fixed value.

name: store_byte_in_object_field

name: allocate_object_slot_with_parts

name: stub_immediate_return

name: clear_all_object_slots
description: Walks all 32 object slots and, for each occupied one, copies its type word into the owner record it points to, clears the slot and decrements the live-object counter. It returns the last value it copied.

name: step_vertical_offset_countdown

name: dispatch_object_state_handler

name: dispatch_object_state_entry

name: toggle_object_flag_bit
description: Clears the top bit of a status byte in the object and then flips its lowest bit. Its entry is unreached, so it may be stray code, but the instructions themselves are only this two-step bit update.

name: add_position_record_when_room
description: Adds a position record to a list when the list has room, computing its placement from a parameter and a fixed base and adjusting it to fit a visible region. If the list is full, it calls a helper instead.

name: add_position_record_if_aligned
description: Like its sibling, it adds a position record to a list when there is room, but it writes the record only when a computed horizontal adjustment is zero. When the list is full it calls a helper.

name: return_zero_after_helper_check
description: When a status word is zero it calls one helper, then always returns zero to its caller.

name: service_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Walks four bit flags in a shared state word, recording each one set and calling a handler when the matching bit in the interrupt request register is also set. It repeats until no flagged bit is left.

name: update_timed_position_record
description: Counts down a timer on a record and, depending on its mode, copies a computed or stored position into the caller's fields or writes a fixed marker. It then stores a link to the caller's field and returns its input value.

name: update_audio_channel_state
description: Updates one sound channel's output fields from stored values. When a pending restart flag is set, it clears the flag, reloads the channel's data pointer and length from stored values, and picks a loop or stop state from another value.

name: update_audio_channel_record
description: Performs the same channel update as its sibling, reading the channel record through an address register, clearing a restart flag, reloading the data pointer and length, and picking a loop or stop state. Audio DMA and interrupt registers are touched by this routine.

name: tick_channel_delay_counter
description: Calls three helpers, then, while a channel flag is set, counts a delay byte down and calls a helper when the count reaches zero. It returns the last value it holds.

name: tick_channel_delay_record
description: If a channel record's counter is nonzero, it reads a value from the record and, when the record's delay byte is zero or has counted down to zero, calls a helper for that value. It returns the value read, or its input value when the counter is zero.

name: step_channel_envelope_phase
description: Steps a channel's volume envelope through its phases, each reading a rate from an envelope table and moving the volume toward a target level. The phase advances when the target is reached, and the last phase holds the volume at a fixed level.

name: update_sound_channels_tick
description: Runs one tick of the sound driver across four channels, counting down timers, applying the envelope and a pitch offset, and handling any pending script command. Audio DMA and interrupt registers are touched by this routine.

name: parse_channel_script_commands
description: Reads script bytes for one sound channel, where byte 128 stores the next byte in a channel field. Any other byte looks up a value in a table, resets the channel's timers and runs the per-channel update before reading on.

name: parse_channel_script_copy
description: Repeats the script command loop of its neighbouring routine. Its entry is not reached by normal flow, so it may be a duplicate left in a gap of the executable.

name: restart_channel_script_parse
description: Starts the script command loop at the channel's saved script start position instead of the current position. The loop then works as in its neighbouring routines: byte 128 stores the following byte in a channel field, and other bytes are looked up and processed.

name: parse_channel_script_scaled
description: Stores the first script byte multiplied by a scale value in a channel's duration field, then runs the shared script command loop. Byte 128 stores the following byte, and other bytes are looked up and processed.

name: parse_channel_script_period_divide
description: Stores a fixed constant of 750 divided by the first script byte in a sound driver variable, then runs the shared script command loop.

name: sum_script_bytes_scaled
description: Adds up a run of script bytes whose count comes from the first byte, stores the total multiplied by a scale value in a channel field, then runs the shared script command loop. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap in the executable.

name: load_instrument_then_parse_script
description: Copies a 15-byte definition from a table, selected by the first script byte, into the channel's parameter fields and clears its counters. It then runs the shared script command loop.

name: parse_channel_script_unreached
description: Repeats the shared script command loop from the position after the opcode. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may be stray code in a gap.

name: load_envelope_then_parse_script
description: Loads a 14-byte envelope entry, selected by the first script byte, into the channel's envelope fields, then runs the shared script command loop.

name: start_script_from_table_entry
description: Starts the shared script command loop at a position read from a table, selected by the first script byte. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may be stray code in a gap.

name: copy_word_pair_three_times
description: Copies two word fields from one record to two other offsets within the same record, and repeats that pair of copies three times, moving the record pointer by one word each time.

name: copy_word_pair_twice
description: Copies two word fields from one record to two other offsets within the same record, repeating the pair of copies for two consecutive words.

name: unrecovered_decompile_timeout
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show a 12-instruction routine that is called through an address reference by one other routine and uses no hardware registers, so its behaviour cannot be recovered.

name: configure_blitter_shift_and_start

name: blit_shifted_plane_rows

name: blit_masked_plane_rows

name: walk_text_string_advances
description: Walks a byte-coded string until its zero terminator. Spaces advance the position by a fixed amount, control bytes adjust it using the following byte, and other characters look up an advance in a table.

name: advance_text_stream_position
description: Walks the same kind of byte-coded string as its neighbours. A carriage-return code doubles the position and adds a step, the space code adds a fixed amount, control bytes adjust the position, and other characters look up an advance in a table.

name: accumulate_text_advances

name: walk_text_string_reload_code
description: Walks a byte-coded string to its terminator. Control code minus one reloads the position from the following byte and continues, while spaces, carriage returns and other characters are handled like the sibling walkers.

name: walk_text_string_add_code
description: Walks a byte-coded string to its terminator. Control code minus two adds the following byte to the position and continues, while spaces, carriage returns and other characters are handled like the sibling walkers.

name: walk_text_string_jump_code
description: Walks a byte-coded string to its terminator. Control code minus three adds the following byte to the position and continues, while spaces, carriage returns and other characters are handled like the sibling walkers.

name: compute_blitter_shift_masks
description: Searches a six-word table for the first word with the lowest bit set, then again for the next bit, and shifts a value by the two positions it found. It sets the blitter's shift control value.

name: step_blitter_row_pointers
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then loops over a count of rows, setting the source and destination pointer registers and advancing both addresses by a stride after each row.

name: set_blitter_copy_defaults
description: Writes default blitter values: the first and last word masks, a copy-mode control value and zero modulo values. These are plain register writes with no waiting.

name: run_blitter_single_source_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets its masks and control values for a single-source copy, loads the source pointer and a size value, then waits again for the operation to finish.

name: start_blitter_two_source_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets its masks and control values, loads the two source pointers and a size value, and starts the operation.

name: blit_four_plane_strips
description: Waits for the blitter, then issues four blitter operations for bitplane strips at fixed offsets from a base address. A high bit of the input selects a different start address, and the control values change with the input's low bits.

name: set_blitter_state_partial
description: The recovered pseudo-code shows only three register writes, although the routine is 149 instructions and also touches blitter, colour and DMA registers. Only those three writes can be described.

name: relay_helper_result
description: Calls a helper and then copies its result to a global value, which has no further effect. It returns to its caller.

name: fill_stepped_long_table
description: Fills a table with four 32-bit values, each larger than the last by a step, and then writes a fifth value from a second base. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap in the executable.

name: choose_mask_and_fill_table
description: Chooses a bit mask from several conditions on a state value, then fills a table of stepped 32-bit values in the same way as its sibling routine. The background colour register is also touched by this routine.

name: update_scroll_tile_position
description: Updates a scroll record by moving its horizontal and vertical positions by stored speeds, splitting each into a fraction and a whole part, and recomputing the record's tile column and row by dividing the position by fixed sizes.

name: run_counted_helper_loops
description: Runs a group of conditional counted loops, each calling a helper a number of times set by its count with a different step rule. The first branch runs a helper loop over 19 rows of 15 entries and then returns.

name: lookup_doubled_table_value
description: Computes a table index from the high bits of a value, reads a 16-bit entry from a fixed table and doubles it.

name: compute_tile_row_address
description: Computes the address of a tile row from a record's base address and a row index taken from a value, scaled by a row length of 38 bytes and an offset, then aligned to a 16-unit boundary.

name: store_row_address_and_step
description: Stores an address adjusted by an offset in a record, calls helpers for 19 rows, then writes four address values with a fixed step to the output.

name: store_negative_row_address_step

name: store_double_then_call_helper
description: Stores twice a working value into a record field, then calls a helper fifteen times.

name: store_sum_then_call_helper
description: Stores a value made from the working value doubled and offset by 36 into a record field, then calls a helper fifteen times.

name: blit_column_strips
description: Calculates a column offset from a row value and the row length. When the offset is nonzero, it waits for the blitter and issues four blitter operations in a strip, setting the modulo values for the strip.

name: initialise_fixed_record_constants

name: write_stepped_copper_entries

name: toggle_paired_state_values

name: dispatch_handler_by_index
description: Calls one of several handlers chosen from a jump table by a shared index value, then returns. The table could not be recovered, so the handler targets are not named.

name: dispatch_handler_from_index
description: Calls one of several handlers chosen from a jump table by a shared index value, then returns. The table could not be recovered, so the handler targets are not named.

name: setup_tile_blit_parameters
description: When an enable value is nonzero, it computes a tile position from two inputs, waits for the blitter to be idle, then programs its masks, control and size registers and sets the source and destination offsets. Its entry is unreached by normal flow.

name: setup_blitter_for_row
description: When an enable value is nonzero, it sets a source offset from a shift value, waits for the blitter, writes its mask and size registers and stores a fixed base address. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: dispatch_after_two_helpers
description: Calls two helpers, then calls a handler chosen from a jump table by a shared index. The table could not be recovered, so the handler targets are not named.

name: run_two_helpers_then_dispatch
description: Calls two helpers, then calls a handler chosen from a jump table by a shared index. The table could not be recovered, so the handler targets are not named.

name: copy_tile_block_rows
description: Copies a 16 by 16 block of tile words from a source table into a destination area, writing each word to two positions 16 words apart. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: write_indexed_pattern_entries
description: Calls a helper for each index from zero to four, then writes fixed pairs of 32-bit values into a set of list entries that depend on the index. The background colour register is also touched by this routine.

name: clear_matching_records_for_key
description: Walks the first given number of 26-byte records. For each active record whose key matches the input, it calls a helper and clears the record's active word.

name: clear_matching_records_in_range
description: Walks the 26-byte record table and, for each active record whose key matches the input and whose stored values fall in certain ranges, calls a helper and clears the record's active word. Index values are handled by two different range tests.

name: blit_sprite_part_with_masks
description: Positions a sprite part from its record fields and a shift value, computes blitter masks from its flags, and programs the blitter with source and destination pointers for row strips. It has two layouts, one with a row offset and one without, each issuing four blitter operations.

name: find_free_list_entry

name: clear_active_list_entries
description: Sets blitter masks and control values, then walks up to 32 ten-byte entries in a list, calling a helper for each entry whose status word is nonzero and clearing that word.

name: blit_wrapped_plane_strips
description: Waits for the blitter, then issues groups of four blitter operations for plane strips at fixed offsets. When a computed column overflows the row width of 224, it splits the copy into two parts and wraps to the start of the row.

name: call_helper_four_times_reset
description: Sets a base value, calls a helper four times, then clears three working variables.

name: clear_all_record_active_words
description: Walks 32 of the 26-byte records from a fixed table and clears each record's active word.

name: map_underscore_to_all_ones
description: If a byte equals the underscore character, it clears the byte and sets it to all ones. Any other value is left unchanged.

name: copy_fixed_block_four_times
description: Copies four 16-byte blocks from a fixed source table to a fixed destination area. The background colour register is touched by this routine.

name: stub_infinite_loop
description: The routine does nothing but loop forever, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover. Its entry is unreached by normal flow.

name: poll_helper_until_code
description: If a flag is set, it clears the flag and returns. Otherwise it calls a helper repeatedly until the helper returns 252, then clears the flag and returns.

name: enable_audio_dma_channels
description: Sets the location and length registers of the four audio channels to fixed values and writes a DMA control value with the enable bit set. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: read_vertical_beam_position
description: Reads the video beam's vertical position register pair and returns a nine-bit line value.

name: install_interrupt_vectors_and_copper
description: Fills a block of low-memory vectors with a fixed value, installs two interrupt handler addresses and a further set of handler addresses, then configures interrupt enable and copper registers. Its entry is unreached by normal flow.

name: pulse_serial_mode_bit

name: check_interrupt_request_level
description: Reads an interrupt request flag word and, when one bit is set and a condition holds, calls a helper and caps its result at 255. It returns the flag word masked to its low three bits.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte

name: mask_flag_word_group
description: Keeps only one group of bits in a flag word and returns. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: The routine only returns, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover.

name: read_joystick_direction_bits

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decompiler reports bad instruction data here, so only part of the routine is recoverable. The visible code matches a key code against a table and sets state flags for particular key codes.

name: set_flags_for_key_codes

name: busy_wait_store_masked_value

name: busy_wait_store_wide_mask

name: busy_wait_store_split_mask
description: Runs a delay loop of 10,000 iterations, storing a value masked with two separate bit groups on each pass. It has no other effect.

name: busy_wait_colour_register_mask
description: Runs a delay loop of 10,000 iterations, storing a masked value on each pass. The background colour register is also touched by this routine.

description: Shifts a 32-bit register left by one bit, then sets its lowest bit according to two bit tests on the old value.

name: advance_cycle_counter_and_scramble

name: format_number_as_decimal_text

name: write_stepped_pointer_table

name: stub_no_operation_return

name: process_four_nonzero_table_bytes
description: Walks four bytes starting at a table offset, and for each nonzero byte calls a helper with the byte's position. It returns the last value it holds.

name: scan_four_records_nonzero

name: advance_four_counters_until_limit
description: When a flag is set, it increments four counters together. When the first counter exceeds 63, it resets all four and sets a completion bit in the flag word.

name: decode_packed_flag_byte

name: initialise_flag_byte_stream
description: Writes an end marker into a buffer, sets the stream pointer to the byte after it, and clears the counter and the state word. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: write_cia_a_value_bytes
description: Sets a state word from its previous value and writes the low and high bytes of a value to two fixed CIA-A memory locations.

name: write_cia_b_value_bytes
description: Sets a control value in the CIA-B register block, then writes the low and high bytes of a value to two fixed CIA-B memory locations.

name: call_helper_over_strided_values
description: Calls a helper once for each value in a counted series, starting from a value taken from the input and stepping by two each time, and increments a counter on each call.

name: update_sprite_entry_controls
description: Waits for the blitter, stores a table value only when it changes, then writes control words for a sprite-like entry. It computes flag bits from the entry's position and issues up to three row copies.

description: Copies ten groups of four words from a source area into a destination, placing two of the words in a second plane at a fixed distance. The blitter mask and modulo registers are touched by this routine.

name: wait_blitter_then_record_pointers
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle four times, then records two pointer values and a size constant for the blitter's pointer and size registers.

name: wait_for_cleared_flag
description: Clears a flag and waits until it reads zero. The facts also list eighteen helper calls and the background colour and DMA control registers, but the recovered pseudo-code shows only this flag wait.

name: step_counter_with_helpers
description: Returns at once when a counter is nonzero, otherwise it increments the counter, calls helpers and resets the counter to zero at the end. The background colour register is touched by this routine.

name: reset_game_state_constants
description: Clears a block of 3,432 words, calls a helper, then writes a set of starting constants into fixed variables, including counters, limits and a fixed 32-bit constant.

name: fill_sentinel_values
description: Writes all-ones sentinel values to four byte variables and to six long variables.

name: setup_blitter_and_wait
description: Calls three helpers, waits for the blitter to be idle, sets its control and mask values and two size-related constants, then waits for the blitter again.

name: compute_aligned_offset_state
description: Chooses a state value from a few comparisons and, in one case, computes a value rounded to a 16-unit boundary with an offset of 8, then clears several state words.

name: clear_twenty_state_words
description: Writes zero to twenty state words.

name: clear_state_and_set_defaults
description: Clears four state words, then runs three similar checks that each set three state values when their condition holds.

name: update_movement_state_machine
description: Updates a movement state by selecting a timing or velocity constant from a state value, applying a range adjustment, and calling different numbers of helper routines depending on a counter. The decompiler output is too tangled to recover every branch.

name: step_and_clamp_signed_value
description: Steps a value by a fixed increment and clamps it to a limit that depends on a state byte.

name: step_state_and_clamp_upper
description: Advances a small state value by two and clamps it at fixed limits, with one branch handling a zero state and another adding fixed offsets. It calls a helper for the upper range.

name: adjust_state_by_fixed_step
description: Adjusts a value by one of two fixed steps, 12,288 or 24,576, chosen from a state value, and sets a state code of four at the end.

name: adjust_state_clamp_at_eight
description: Adjusts a value by one of two fixed steps, 12,288 or 24,576, depending on its sign, and clamps the resulting state to eight.

name: update_state_with_thresholds
description: Updates a movement state through several threshold tests, setting it to fixed values and returning early when a magnitude is within a small range.

name: compute_capped_high_word_state
description: Adds a constant to a value, takes its high word capped at 15, then sets one of two fixed state codes depending on bits of that word.

name: apply_flag_group_defaults
description: Checks a flag group in a word and calls helpers when it matches, then sets two default values to fixed codes, one of them only when a zero test passes.

name: step_toward_target_within_eight
description: Compares a value with a target and moves the value toward the target by up to eight units when the two are close. Otherwise it clears the value and returns the low bits of the input.

name: update_motion_with_clamped_step
description: Updates a motion value by a clamped step computed from its previous value, with separate handling when a flag is set, and calls helpers around the update. The decompiler output is partly tangled.

name: apply_capped_velocity_step
description: Sets a default value when two conditions hold, calls helpers, then computes a step from a value offset by 5,462. The step is capped at 15 in one direction and 3 in the other, and the value is cleared when a flag is set.

name: apply_capped_velocity_offset
description: Adds an offset of 3,280 to a value, caps the high word of the result at 2 on the positive side and 15 on the negative side, doubles it, then calls helpers and clears the value when a flag is set.

name: run_helper_sequence_clear
description: Calls a sequence of six helpers with register copies between them, then clears the value when a flag is set.

name: move_value_toward_target
description: Moves a value toward a target by a step based on the difference, limited to half the difference after its sign bit is masked. It returns at once when the difference is zero.

name: copy_pair_after_helper
description: Calls a helper, then copies two register values into two global variables.

name: copy_pair_after_helper_twin
description: Calls a helper, then copies two register values into two global variables. The code is the same as its sibling routine.

name: subtract_and_correct_negative
description: Subtracts a register value from a global, and when the result is negative and within a range, adds twice the register value back. It then sets a state value to one.

name: add_and_correct_overflow
description: Adds a register value to a global, subtracts twice that value when the sum is nonnegative and above a limit, then sets a state value to two.

name: subtract_and_clamp_state_four
description: Subtracts a register value from a global and, when the result is negative, adds the register value back in some cases. It always sets the state to four.

name: add_and_clamp_state_eight
description: Adds a register value to a global and, when the sum is nonnegative and its high word is below nine, subtracts the register value again. It always sets the state to eight.

name: adjust_value_by_capped_steps
description: Chooses a limit of 12,288 or 8,192 from a flag, then adjusts a value by up to fifteen steps in the direction of its sign, with a second step that depends on a bit test.

name: adjust_value_capped_steps_copy
description: Adjusts a value by up to fifteen steps in the direction of its sign, the same as its sibling routine, with a second step that depends on a bit test.

name: step_value_by_capped_amount
description: Moves a value by up to fifteen units in the direction of its sign, with a second step that depends on a bit test.

name: add_clamped_step_to_value
description: Clamps an input value to the range from minus fifteen to plus fifteen, then adds it to a global value.

name: conditional_threshold_step_helper
description: When a state word is zero, it clears the high word of a value. When the value passes a threshold test, it calls a helper and returns the helper's result combined with the value.

name: adjust_by_stepped_multiples
description: When a state word is one, it moves a value by up to four steps of 8,192 toward or away from zero, depending on the sign of the difference between two inputs.

name: stub_gap_return_routine
description: The routine returns without any effect on every path. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: search_word_pair_table
description: Searches a table of word pairs for an entry that matches a key derived from the input. When it finds a match with a high-byte flag, it updates a counter table entry and sets a result value, and it stops at a terminator.

name: increment_indexed_counter_entry
description: Calls a helper with a fixed index, then increments a counter entry in a table at a fixed offset. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: update_position_with_clamped_limits
description: Updates a position value toward a target, clamping the change within limits and handling a few special state codes. It calls helpers, sets a default state of 16 for three state codes and clamps the result to a non-negative range.

name: update_position_within_bounds
description: Compares a position with an input and, when they are close, moves the position by a bounded difference and clamps it at zero. Otherwise it applies a fixed bound and clamps the result at zero.

name: advance_table_counter_twice
description: Twice, when a counter is nonzero, adds a byte looked up at the counter's index to a value and then decrements the counter.

name: select_masked_state_value
description: Chooses a state value from a few tests on a counter, calling helpers in some cases, and returns it masked with a bit pattern. The decompiler output is only partly readable.

name: set_state_codes_by_counter
description: When a state word is zero and negative, it picks a fixed code from a chain of tests and sets state fields to fixed values, such as 172 and 125.

name: set_state_codes_gap
description: Uses the same state-code chain as its neighbouring routine, with a different fixed value in one branch. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: reset_state_code_when_zero
description: When a state code is zero it sets a fixed value and clears related fields, handling one value specially. Otherwise it sets the state code to 255.

name: set_state_seven_defaults
description: Sets a state to 255 when it is nonzero, then, when the state is not seven, sets it to seven and sets several related fields to fixed values.

name: select_fixed_offset_by_flag
description: Sets a state value to one of two fixed offsets depending on a flag, then clears the state. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: clear_to_fixed_offset
description: Sets a state value to a fixed offset, then clears it to zero. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: advance_state_with_constant
description: When a state is zero, it adds a constant of 500,000 and then adds one, using a special value of 52 for a zero result. Otherwise it sets the state to four.

name: transition_state_from_table
description: Updates a state through a table-driven transition, selecting a starting entry from a series of tests and then following a chain of table offsets until it reaches a non-negative one. The decompiler output is too tangled to recover every branch.

name: follow_offset_table_chain
description: Steps a counter back, then follows a chain of table offsets until it reaches a non-negative entry, moving the pointer by that entry.

name: lookup_tile_flag_value
description: Looks up a tile entry in a table from two position values and checks its flag bits. When the flags are set it computes a sample from a second table, and it returns the tile value in a global.

name: lookup_tile_neighbour_value
description: Looks up a tile entry in a table by position, then checks neighbouring entries in the same table and keeps one whose flag bits are set.

name: move_value_toward_target_gap
description: Moves a value toward a target by a step based on the difference, limited to half the difference after its sign bit is masked. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.

name: step_value_limited_by_input
description: When its input is at most 21, subtracts a step from a global value, halving the step when the difference is positive and large, and adds to it when the input is negative. Its entry is unreached by normal flow.

name: add_secondary_offset
description: Adds a secondary offset from a data register to a global value. Its entry is unreached by normal flow.

name: subtract_halved_offset_when_larger
description: Subtracts an offset from a global value, halving the input first when it is larger than the offset. Its entry is unreached by normal flow.

name: subtract_secondary_offset
description: Subtracts a secondary offset from a data register from a global value. Its entry is unreached by normal flow.

name: stub_return_no_effect
description: The routine only returns, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover.

name: stub_return_unreached
description: The routine only returns, so it is a stub with no behaviour to recover. Its entry is unreached by normal flow, so it may come from a gap.
